scripts.dev: node scripts/generate-registry.mjs && node scripts/generate-style-lab-tokens.mjs && next dev -p 3030
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-registry.mjs && node scripts/generate-style-lab-tokens.mjs && node scripts/copy-hosted-storybook.mjs && next build
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-style-lab-tokens.mjs --check && node scripts/check-catalog-imports.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/generate-style-lab-tokens.mjs --check && node scripts/check-catalog-imports.mjs && vitest run --coverage --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reportOnFailure '--coverage.include=scripts/**/*.mjs'
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/generate-registry.mjs && node scripts/generate-style-lab-tokens.mjs && tsc --noEmit --emitDeclarationOnly false --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile ./tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
